name: aws_sqs_get_queue_attributes
title: Get SQS queue attributes
description: Returns the attributes of one queue (backlog counts, visibility timeout, dead-letter queue settings, etc.)

attribute_names.description: Attribute names to get. Defaults to all attributes

profile.description: AWS profile name. If omitted, the awscli default resolution applies

region.description: AWS region (e.g. ap-northeast-1). If omitted, the awscli default resolution applies

Attributes.description: Map of attribute names to values (SQS GetQueueAttributes response)

lines.description: Output split into lines (success only). Returned when the output is not a JSON object: commands without JSON output, empty output, or warnings only

output.description: Beginning of the redacted output when it exceeds the limit (success only, together with truncated)

truncated.description: true when the output exceeded the limit and output holds only its beginning (success only)

kind.description: Failure kind (failure only): not-allowed / invalid-input = rejected before running, timeout, awscli-missing, and the awscli failure kinds

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

log.description: Redacted awscli output, only the beginning when it exceeds the limit (failure only)

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run, such as top-level keys of the awscli JSON output that the tool does not declare and dropped (omitted when there are none)
